questions.prompt: A client is waiting, but the treatment room has not completed its required cleaning. What is the best solution?
options: Allow the client in immediately to avoid delay
Complete the required cleaning and communicate any necessary delay
Ask the client to ignore the room condition

questions.prompt: A payment discrepancy is discovered. What is the best solution?
options: Record only verified information and report the discrepancy

questions.prompt: Two employees disagree about a task assignment. What is the best solution?
options: Discuss the disagreement with unrelated colleagues
Check the assigned procedure and seek clarification

questions.prompt: A new employee is struggling with a task. What is the best solution?
options: Provide appropriate guidance and supervised practice
Complete every task for the employee indefinitely

questions.prompt: An employee is overwhelmed during a busy shift. What is the best solution?
options: Request appropriate assistance and clarify priorities
